text: Not a brilliant turn of events, but the ruins were\nbrought into the light for us to see...[VAR 0114(000B)]
What does this tell us about Galar’s legends?[VAR 0114(000B)]

Right! More than any hero, there’s those things
that appear to be Pokémon that stand out!\c
Not just that, but those Pokémon appear to be
holding a sword and shield as if they were
using them![VAR 0114(000B)]
Anything else look interesting to you?[VAR 0114(000B)]

Oh, good observation!\c
There really were two heroes. But if that’s the
case, then why only the one statue at the
Budew Drop Inn?[VAR 0114(000B)]
More than any statue of a hero or old tapestry,\nthese ruins made in truly ancient times must show\r\nus the real truth.[VAR 0114(000B)]

Yup! I was thinking the same thing!\c
Seems like at some point in history the sword and
shield were combined with the two actual
Pokémon and treated as the same thing...\c
But then what? They just faded from history?[VAR 0114(000B)]

Two young heroes... The sword and shield were
actually Pokémon... But why would the truth of
these ruins be hidden when their stories were
depicted in artwork?[VAR 0114(000B)]

With your help, I really feel like we made a big
discovery here. Thanks! I’ll give you a couple of
these, so you keep giving it your best in the
Gym Challenge, too, OK?\c
Guess you’ll be headed to Ballonlea next, right?[VAR 0114(000B)]
So... There was history being covered up by all\nthat over-stylized artwork... I’m gonna have to\r\nlook into this some more.[VAR 0114(000B)]
